name: Firfire Caverns
desc:
The Firfire Caverns is a large cave system found in the [Second Layer](location:the_ethironal_shrine). It is extremely dangerous; the ceiling will often collapse, and it contains every single monster found in the 1st Floor of the 2nd Layer. Its entrance will be locked if the player does not first activate the generator.

It contains two exits. The first one leads to the [Firfire Village](location:firfire), and the second is locked until the player talks to the village chief with the Ethiron's Gaze Talent, leading to the [Nest Corridor](location:nest_corridor).

Brief hallucinations of Bounder faces occasionally appear for a split second in the Firfire Caverns. These are only visual and serve to scare players (see Ghost Bounder).
additional_info:
-   The Spear of Nakti is a reference to the game's main composer, Naktigonis.
-   For a guide on how to **exit** the caverns, click here at the timestamp 4:23
-   For a guid on how to **enter** the caverns, click here at the timestamp 9:38
